'''Gogh Pleetik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] executive in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Pleetik owned a rare [[hypergem]] which was stolen from his office by a thief hired by [[Kaird]], a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. Kaird planned to discredit [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the theft by selling the hypergem to [[Endrigorn]], a fence Xizor had regular dealings with.<ref name="JT" />
